name: billr
description: Connect to hosted Billr to review unbilled work, log time and expenses, and draft invoices and estimates. Requires a Billr account. Sending or payment actions require your explicit request and permission.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Billr business to review unpaid invoices and unbilled work, log time and expenses, and draft invoices and estimates. Requires a Billr account and applicable plan access. Reads are limited to your approved business and permissions. Sending, payment and deletion actions require an explicit request and the corresponding permission.
